figurative_meaning_en: A poor person who indulges in fancy clothes, an outwardly sophisticated individual
similar_in_english: all dressed up and nowhere to go
clothes make the man (but he's broke)
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে একটা কাপড়েবাবু, বাইরে থেকে দেখলে ধনী বলে মনে হয় কিন্তু আসলে খুবই অভাবী।
অফিসে নতুন যোগদানকারী কাপড়েবাবু, সবাইকে ইমপ্রেস করার চেষ্টা করছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He is a kapore babu; he looks wealthy from the outside but is actually very poor.
The new office joiner is a kapore babu, trying to impress everyone with his appearance.
note: This idiom satirizes colonial-era influences on Bengali middle-class aspirations for Western-style sophistication despite economic constraints.
